subject: ACK D-06 mig0 instantiate CANDIDATE not MIG_PASS
body:
A ACK D-06 105618. Absorbed. mig0 in arty_a7_mig_top is CANDIDATE bind synth, PROGRAM=NO.

NOT MIG_PASS / BOARD_PASS / TIMING_PASS / FEM_PERSIST_PASS. FEM dest still local. Live 23.9 still unbound mig0 on arty_a7_r2_top (085241 not rematched; A does not write 23).

A does not freeze ui_clk, LUT/FF/BRAM, or WNS -1.490. schema_lock still omits 05 (072711 not rematched). SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH=32. Not PASS. A does not write RTL.
